title: Advertise assetDownloadUrl and use the template in the agent instead of the fixed /jmap/asset path
description: jmap-chat-spec 92fecd6 adds assetUrl and assetDownloadUrl (templates) to the account-level mimi capability (Mark 2026-11-19). mimid-server: advertise assetDownloadUrl = {base}/jmap/asset/{accountId}?room={roomId}&url={url}-style per RFC 6570 level 1 (adjust the route if a template variable can't express accountId: use the account's own path), keep assetUrl; agent-core client.rs: read the template from the session and expand it instead of formatting the fixed path; drop INVENTED markers that the draft now covers (cite the draft). After the crate-jmap typed fields land, use them (crate-jmap request sent).
